raw_extract:
Tuition fees for international students (1,500.00 euros per semester)

Legal basis
The information below is intended to outline the relevant law and the related procedures; the sole legally binding document is the Landeshochschulgebührengesetz des Landes Baden-Württemberg.
Tuition fee exceptions will be granted automatically in the following cases: 	Students who are citizens of an EU or EEA member state, 	Students enrolling for a doctoral program, 	Students on exchanges arising from partnership agreements with the University of Tübingen (e.g. Erasmus), 	Double Degree students from partner institutions abroad [...]
From the winter semester 2021/2022, students form the United Kingdom who wish to enroll in an undergraduate degree program (=Bachelor's degree program, Staatsexamens program and full Theology programs culminating in an academic or ecclesiastic qualification) or a consecutive Master's degree program at the University of Tübingen will be charged a tuition fee of 1,500 euros per semester. The tuition fee would not be charged in case of an exception or exemption.
research_notes: SECOND independent Baden-Württemberg university confirming the same EUR 1,500 per semester non-EU Bachelor tuition. Two independent official university pages plus the state ministry all agree on 1,500 EUR/semester for Baden-Württemberg, so this figure is well corroborated. This page states the fee in the page title itself, and explicitly ties it to the undergraduate/Bachelor degree programme. Note it also demonstrates a Brexit-specific consequence: UK students enrolling from WS 2021/22 became fee-liable for undergraduate programmes. GAP: this page does NOT state a separate mandatory semester contribution figure, unlike the Stuttgart page — so the semester fee cannot be assumed identical at Tübingen.

claims.statement: The University of Tübingen charges international students from outside the EU/EEA a tuition of 1,500.00 euros per semester for undergraduate degree programmes.

From the winter semester 2021/2022, students from the United Kingdom enrolling in an undergraduate degree programme at the University of Tübingen are charged a tuition fee of 1,500 euros per semester.
